widgets_values: Up to 9 reference images can be connected. To skip one, bypass its group.
Up to 3 reference videos (2-15 s each, 15 s total). These define camera movement style and motion logic.
Up to 3 reference audio clips (must be paired with an image or video, 15 s total). These set rhythm, dialogue and ambient sound.

SINGLE-PASS (fastest):
Leave Stage 2 bypassed. In the Resolution Selector choose the size you want -
0.9 is recommended, which outputs 720p directly.

TWO-PASS (higher quality):
If you enable Stage 2, lower the Stage 1 resolution first - 0.4 is recommended.
Pass 1 runs fast at low resolution, then pass 2 re-samples at fewer steps and
raises the resolution. Tune it to your hardware and needs (too high hurts speed).

TIP: when running locally, leave Stage 2 off while you roll seeds. Once you get
a result you like, lock the seed and turn Stage 2 on to strengthen it.

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the walking woman whose face and hair come from <Picture 1> and whose outfit comes from <Picture 2>.
<Picture 3> is the environment: a dark minimalist penthouse entrance foyer at night, black stone walls, a thin red LED line tracing the ceiling and door frame, a dark marble console table with a vase and stacked books, a large abstract painting on the left wall, floor-to-ceiling windows on the right showing a rain-streaked night skyline through vertical black fins, and a tall black double door with a red LED seam down its center, now standing open with <Subject 1> holding it.
<Subject 2> is the first-person camera operator, a man who stays off camera. The only part of him that may ever appear is his bare right hand and bare forearm: clean skin, no watch, no ring, no bracelet, no cuff, no sleeve, entering from the bottom edge of the frame like a vlogger's hand after filming on a smartphone. Every appearance must be that same bare hand.
<Audio 1> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 1> (S2).
<Audio 2> is the voice-timbre reference for <Subject 2> (S1).

summary:
[reference generation + audio reference] A 10-second first-person smartphone POV closing scene at the entrance foyer of <Picture 3>, ending the house tour. The framing is tight and intimate throughout, a head-and-chest close-up like a street interview, never pulling back to a wide shot. <Subject 1> holds the open door at close range while the off-camera guest thanks her for the tour, she invites him back any time, and he says a warm goodbye. <Audio 1> and <Audio 2> supply the two voice timbres only; no audio signal is copied.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - her identity from <Picture 1> and her outfit from <Picture 2> are retained unchanged and stay large and clearly readable in the close frame throughout.
<Picture 3> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the black stone walls, red LED seams, and open black door are retained as a soft background behind her.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - only a bare, unadorned right hand and bare forearm appear, always consistent.
<Audio 1>: reference - voice timbre and delivery guide the woman's lines without copying the original signal.
<Audio 2>: reference - voice timbre and delivery guide the man's lines without copying the original signal.

detailed_description:
The target video is a realistic first-person smartphone POV with a cinematic night-interior grade, close and intimate framing at head-and-chest distance throughout, never widening to a full body or establishing shot, with warm skin tones lifted off the red LED accents and only slight handheld micro-drift.
[Shot 1] The scene opens already close on <Subject 1>, a head-and-chest close-up in the open doorway of <Picture 3>, one hand holding the door frame just at the edge of frame, her face large and clearly lit, the red LED seam glowing softly out of focus behind her. At 00:01.500 the off-screen man's voice (S1), warm and genuine, with the timbre of <Audio 2>, says, <d>[English] Thank you so much for showing me your house today, this was really cool.</d> <Subject 1> (S2) smiles warmly, her expression filling the frame, and replies in a relaxed, easy tone with the timbre of <Audio 1>, <d>[English] Of course, anytime.</d> At 00:04.000 the man's voice (S1) asks, a little hopeful, <d>[English] Mind if I post this on YouTube?</d> <Subject 1> (S2) laughs lightly, still held close in frame, and says, <d>[English] For sure. Let me know how it goes. And if you ever want another tour—</d> she trails off with a playful, open smile. At 00:07.000 the man's voice (S1), cutting in warmly, says, <d>[English] I definitely will. Thanks again!</d> <Subject 1> (S2) laughs once more and gives a small close, warm wave, her face and smile held clearly in the tight frame through the final frame as the scene settles on her expression.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet interior room tone, a faint hum from the red LED strip lighting, soft distant rain against the tall windows, a light gust of night air through the open door, and close-mic natural dialogue for both voices.

non_diegetic_music:
The minimal synthwave underscore returns for the close: a low bass pulse and a sparse airy pad, swelling gently and warmly under the farewell lines and holding softly through the final smile.
